description: Curated Aedes-borne flavivirus host-dependency factors from published genome-scale CRISPR screens and the Krogan flavivirus host-pathogen interactome. Each gene is a candidate host-directed antiviral target. Provenance is the study that nominated it; live evidence is pulled at runtime from Open Targets, DGIdb and Europe PMC.

genes.role: Catalytic subunit of the oligosaccharyltransferase (OST) complex; N-glycosylation of viral structural/NS proteins.
genes.source: Marceau et al., Nature 2016 — genome-scale CRISPR screen for Flaviviridae host factors

genes.role: OST catalytic paralog; post-translational N-glycosylation required for flavivirus replication.
Non-catalytic OST subunit; supports viral glycoprotein maturation.
STT3B-specific OST subunit with oxidoreductase activity; flavivirus dependency factor.
Signal peptidase complex subunit; cleavage of the flavivirus polyprotein at ER membrane.
genes.source: Zhang et al., Cell Reports 2016 — signal peptide processing pathway required by flaviviruses

genes.role: Signal peptidase complex subunit; required for structural protein processing.
ER membrane protein complex (EMC) subunit; biogenesis of viral multipass membrane proteins (NS4A/NS4B).
genes.source: Barrows et al., Cell Reports 2019; Marceau et al., Nature 2016

genes.role: EMC subunit; flavivirus membrane-protein biogenesis chaperone.
EMC insertase core; required for NS4B accumulation.
AAA+ ATPase (p97); ERAD and membrane extraction co-opted for flavivirus replication. Chemically tractable.
ER chaperone (GRP78/BiP); folding of viral glycoproteins and UPR modulation.
genes.source: Royle et al., 2020; multiple flavivirus proteomics

genes.role: Sec61 translocon subunit; co-translational insertion of viral proteins; Krogan interactome hit.
genes.source: Shah et al., Cell 2018 — comparative flavivirus-host protein interaction map (Krogan lab)

genes.role: Ribosomal scaffold protein; cap-independent translation support; flavivirus interactome hit.
TAM receptor tyrosine kinase; proposed ZIKV entry cofactor (cell-type dependent; role contested). Kinase-tractable.
genes.source: Meertens et al., Cell Reports 2017; Nowakowski et al., Cell Stem Cell 2016
